## Check list

- [ ] The validator passes (`.venv/bin/python scripts/validate_skills.py`).
- [ ] The tests pass (`ruff check .`, `mypy scripts tests`, `pytest -m "not network"`).
- [ ] The skill has an "Adapt this skill" section.
- [ ] The skill gets its data through the base skill (`s1ft` skill).
- [ ] The skill has no personal paths or email addresses.
- [ ] The skill describes and does not judge.
